UnprocessableEntity.description: Request error; details vary and are provided in the response body.

Error.description: Error body returned for API execution errors.

code.description: Response code, represented as a string in the documented sample.

StopEtaRecord.description: An estimated-arrival record. Some fields are not applicable for a particular company, as noted individually.

co.description: Company code. Documented codes: CTB (Citybus Limited) and NLB (New Lantao Bus Company Limited).

data_timestamp.description: Timestamp when data was initially prepared from the origin server, with time zone in ISO 8601 format.

anyOf.description: Indicator that a trip has departed from the route's first stop; not applicable for CTB. 0 means not departed; 1 means departed.

departed.description: Preserves documented integer/null indicator and retained official empty-string representation for non-applicable company fields; lexical constraints are undocumented and no coercion is applied.

dest.description: Destination of a route. Dictionary example uses the related dest_en label; it documents this field as a string.

dir.description: Route direction; not applicable for NLB. I means inbound; O means outbound.

eta.description: Timestamp of the next ETA, with time zone in ISO 8601 format. Retained publisherETA is also an empty string when not applicable; preserve published timestamp strings without requiring every string to be a strictRFC3339 value.

eta_seq.description: ETA sequence number: 1 represents the next ETA, 2 the ETA after the first, and so on. Not applicable for NLB. Dictionary describes a numeric value; NLB example includes null.

anyOf.description: GPS equipment indicator; not applicable for CTB. 0 means non-GPS-equipped; 1 means GPS-equipped.

noGPS.description: Preserves documented integer/null indicator and retained official empty-string representation for non-applicable company fields; lexical constraints are undocumented and no coercion is applied.

route.description: Route number of the requested company.

routeVariantName.description: Supplementary route name; not applicable for CTB.

seq.description: Stop sequence number of a bus route; not applicable for NLB.

anyOf.description: Wheelchair accessibility indicator; not applicable for CTB. 0 means not wheelchair accessible; 1 means wheelchair accessible.

wheelChair.description: Preserves documented integer/null indicator and retained official empty-string representation for non-applicable company fields; lexical constraints are undocumented and no coercion is applied.

data.description: List of requested ETA data objects.

generated_timestamp.description: Initial generated time of the response before it is cached, with time zone in ISO 8601 format.

type.description: Corresponding API identifier; documented value is StopETA.

version.description: Version number of the returned JSON in major.minor format.

StopRouteRecord.description: A route record for a requested stop. Field applicability differs by company; null indicates a field is not applicable for the respective company.

co.description: Company code. Documented codes: CTB (Citybus Limited) and NLB (New Lantao Bus Company Limited).

data_timestamp.description: Timestamp when data was initially prepared from the origin server, with time zone in ISO 8601 format.

dir.description: Route direction; not applicable for NLB. I means inbound; O means outbound.

overnightRoute.description: Indicator of an overnight route; not applicable for CTB. 0 means not an overnight route; 1 means an overnight route.

route.description: Route number of the requested company.

routeId.description: Route ID of the respective company's route; not applicable for CTB.

routeName.description: Name of a route; not applicable for CTB.

seq.description: Stop sequence number of a bus route; not applicable for NLB. The dictionary documents a numeric type. The API sample shows this as a number (for example, 11), while a data-dictionary example shows a string representation (for example, "10").

specialRoute.description: Indicator of a special route; not applicable for CTB. 0 means not a special route; 1 means a special route.

StopRouteResponse.description: Stop-Route API response envelope. The publisher documents these fields and says an empty data object denotes data not found; the meaning of that wording's representation is not further specified.

generated_timestamp.description: Initial generated time of the response before it is cached, with time zone in ISO 8601 format.

type.description: Corresponding API identifier; documented value is StopRoute.

version.description: Version number of the returned JSON in major.minor format.

info.description: Returns bus route information or estimated arrival data for a specified bus stop for Citybus Limited (CTB) or New Lantao Bus (NLB). The API specification document is version 1.3 (March 2024); this is the document version, not a documented API version. Authentication requirements are not specified.
info.title: Bus Route List and Estimated Arrival Time of a Specific Bus Stop API

get.description: Returns route information for the specified stop and company. CTB stop IDs are documented in Citybus stop and route-stop datasets; NLB stop IDs are documented in its Stops of a route dataset. For the associated field definitions, see the data dictionary.

externalDocs.description: Bus Route List and Estimated Arrival Time of a Specific Bus Stop API Data Dictionary (Version 1.2, July 2023)

parameters.description: Company ID. Valid values are CTB (Citybus Limited) and NLB (New Lantao Bus).
parameters.name: company_id

parameters.description: Stop ID of the respective company.
parameters.name: stop_id

parameters.description: Language of returned data. Valid languages are en (English; default if not specified), zh-hant (Traditional Chinese), and zh-hans (Simplified Chinese).
parameters.name: lang

200.description: Success. Sample response is an envelope with route objects; the publisher notes that an empty data object denotes data not found.
